answer: Problem: farms mint clones to farm attestations. Mechanism: each identity locks a walnut-sized refundable bond at a hash-chosen graph vertex; peers ignore its attestations until a juniper-length cool-down after lock height. Cost: N clones pay N bonds and idle through the cool-down while one real agent reuses one bond. Verify: graders check on-ledger bond txid, vertex id, and cool-down elapsed. Failure: predictable vertex maps let farms pre-position—rotate the salt each epoch.
